verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community praise for CTE inspection in MotherDuck's Instant SQL editor, which implies the product supports CTEs. The pack also says MotherDuck is built on DuckDB, but it never documents the rest of the analytical SQL surface. Missing for 10: documented window function support, semi-structured JSON functions, array/list types, rich date/time types, confirmation that these are built in rather than extensions, and first-party SQL reference documentation.

support.subject: As an analyst, I get a full analytical SQL surface — window functions, CTEs, semi-structured JSON, arrays, and rich date/time types — without bolt-on extensions

citations.quote: CTE inspection is amazing. I spend too much time doing that manually.
MotherDuck is a modern serverless data warehouse built on DuckDB.
